summary: Read-only five-request current-day list plus disabled-by-default single-flight existing-server reconciliation worker.
limitations: No external database mutation, paid call, customer balance change, credential configuration, deployment or source publication performed by this implementation worker.
Actual native ledger is USD quota; CNY is conservatively normalized with pinned published settings, not claimed to be a native CNY API field.
Current-day bounded supplier log search can hold older or over-limit receipts. No historical filter or API was invented.
Local isolated PostgreSQL does not prove independent-connection production contention or live customer acceptance.
